selection: Highest pooled interval recall among guardrail-passing candidates; within 0.0005 recall of the best prefer the parameter pair closest to reference in squared log-ratio distance. Quantification uses the fixed complete-pair intersection across baseline and all nine candidates. Freeze selection before loading held-out IDs or producing held-out candidate outputs. No held-out retuning.
limitations: Assignment and shifted-mass diagnostics are proxies, not feature FDR or confirmed false positives. Thresholds are predefined practical tolerances, not significance tests. All models share the same generation gates and downstream filtering.
